paragraphs.body: Dallas Cowboys | Official Site of the Dallas Cowboys reported that quarterback Dak Prescott described the team's recent loss to the Arizona Cardinals as 'one of the toughest' in his career. This assessment followed a game where the Cowboys fell in overtime, prompting significant emotional reactions from their fanbase.

Yahoo Sports highlighted the intense backlash from Cowboys fans, who expressed anger after Dak Prescott shielded head coach Brian Schottenheimer following the overtime defeat against the Cardinals. Social media reactions included fans shouting 'Shut Up' and 'Stop Taking Bullets for Him' at the quarterback.

FOX Sports provided highlights showing Dak Prescott scrambling for a five-yard touchdown run, which helped extend the Cowboys' lead over the Cardinals during the contest. This play occurred amidst the broader narrative of the team's challenging performance in the recent matchup.

headline: Dak Prescott calls Cardinals loss 'toughest' career, fans furious he shielded coach after OT defeat.
